newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. debt futures hold gains on U.S. orders.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. debt futures hold gains on U.S. orders.

text.p: July 2 - Most U.S. debt futures held gains in reaction to the U.S. May factory orders data. Orders were down 0.7 pct, vs avg est of down 0.2 pct and against May's upwardly revised rise of 1.4 pct. Sept T-bonds inched up to 111-27/32, but remain below the daily high of 111-31/32. Resistance is at 112-02/32. (Chicago Derivatives Desk (312)408-8750))
